svg.text: Terraform (remote state) → Azure (NESSUS01, DC01, UBUNTU01, WS01 — domain: lab.local) → CVSS triage → Remediation → CI checks + optional scan pipeline
→ source for every NSG rule below
Cost: $0 — Terraform CLI + git are free
security misconfig scan (network ACLs, purge protection, etc.)
Zero Azure credentials — never connects to Azure, nothing to set up
Network Contributor on the NSG ONLY
Reads NESSUS01_IP/RG/NSG from repo Variables — no terraform, ever
🛡 NSG — lab5-nsg, scoped to your IP only
Scanner → targets: default AllowVNetInBound (no extra rule needed)
run-scan.yml opens/removes its own temp 8834 rule, scoped to runner IP only
Never opened to Internet/* — see main.tf, allowed_source_ip var
VNet DNS server = DC01's private IP (10.0.1.4) → lab.local resolves VNet-wide
🎓 Certification Alignment: CompTIA Security+ · CySA+ · PenTest+
Vulnerability management, CVSS scoring, and remediation workflow — all directly examinable
Workflow: Basic scan → Credentialed scan (3 targets, from NESSUS01) → Findings → CVSS scoring → Remediate → Re-scan → Export PDF report
CI checks run on every push (fmt/validate/tfsec) · scan pipeline is optional and provisions nothing (Section 13)
